text: dsh-deep-search 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的深度检索插件，通过 bundle 将插件加入 profile，并注册 deep_search、research_state 和 verify_claims 工具及系统提示。它支持并行或定向查询多个搜索引擎与平台，跨轮去重并聚合相似来源，返回来源分级、可信度标记、官方消息确认状态和检索缺口；还能保存研究轮次并核对已收集证据中的具体主张。适合需要查找近期信息、比较多个来源或复核事实的 DSH 用户。常规网页搜索可使用匿名引擎；部分搜索渠道与平台需在配置凭据后启用，查询会发送到相应外部搜索服务。

dsh-deep-search adds three tools to DSH: deep_search searches engines or platforms and groups deduplicated results; research_state manages searches; verify_claims compares statements with collected evidence. Some channels need credentials, and queries go to external services.
想把一个问题拆成几轮联网搜索，逐步补全资料。
I need to search several sites and compare the evidence for a current question.
DSH 能不能记住前几轮查到的来源，方便接着研究？
dsh-deep-search 的功能「多轮多源检索」：按查询并行调用搜索引擎或指定平台，对结果去重、聚类并标注来源可信度，随后返回结果、覆盖缺口和后续查询提示。
dsh-deep-search 的功能「研究记录与主张核验」：通过研究状态工具查看、重置或结束已有检索轮次，也可将具体主张与已收集来源匹配，查看支持或反驳证据。
dsh-deep-search 使用前须知：搜索词会发送至所选外部服务；Tavily、Serper、Bocha、Exa、Firecrawl、知乎和 X 渠道需配置相应凭据引用才启用（见 src/credentials.ts:5-13）。

@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search README · dsh-deep-search：> **Stop letting your DSH agent conclude from a single search.**
> Multi-round iterative deep research · 14 platform-targeted retrievers · A/B/C/D source grading · cross-validation · misinformation heuristics.

[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search)
[](./LICENSE)

A one-shot `web_search` answering "has model X shipped?" — with an aggregator's clickbait headline — is how hallucinated facts get into your context.

@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search README · dsh-deep-search：**dsh-deep-search** makes the *plan → parallel-retrieve → parse → rewrite → verify* loop the **default behavior** of a DSH session. The intelligence is your session model; the grunt work (dedup, clustering, trust grading, rumor flags) is the plugin. Zero forced payments: no API key needed for the core platforms; quota-exhausted engines fall to the back of the chain and self-heal.

中文 README：[README.md](./README.md)

@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-deep-search

@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search README · restart DSH (the web profile disables HMR)：```

Then just ask: *"Has Qwen4-Max actually been released?"* — the model auto-loads the deep-research protocol and iterates until it finds A-grade official evidence or honestly reports **not found**.

@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search README · Compared to：- **dsh-web-search-pro**: heavy search infra (cache/evidence-packs/browser); iteration protocol left to you.
- **dsh-free-search**: 19 keyless engines + image wall, single round.
- **dsh-zhihu-search**: single-platform official-API specialist.
- **modsearch**: keyless web/X bridge (X needs local Grok), single shot.

dsh-deep-search coexists with all of them: it never overrides the `ctx.web` seam.

@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search README · 核心能力：| | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🔁 迭代协议默认化 | 系统提示注入 + SKILL：时效/真伪问题自动走多轮（≤5 轮），无需用户催 |
| 🌐 14 平台定向检索 | GitHub · HuggingFace · ModelScope · 知乎 · Reddit · HN · StackOverflow · Wikipedia · V2EX · npm · B站 · 微博 · X(尽力而为) · + 免Key通用引擎(Bing/DDG/SearXNG/Mojeek/Firecrawl) |
| 🧮 可信度分级 A/B/C/D | 官方公告 > 官方互动 > 社区(需交叉验证) > 媒体/未知。数据驱动规则表可扩 |
| 🕵️ 虚假信息信号 | 内容农场 / 标题党 / 讽刺源 / 孤证 / 日期矛盾 / 旧闻 自动打标 |
| 🔗 交叉验证矩阵 | 同事件多源聚类 + 独立域名计数，杜绝"3 家转载当 3 个信源" |
| 🚫 诚实降级 | X/微博/B站 反爬失败 → gaps 明示 `unavailable/degraded`，web 替代绝不冒充 X 覆盖 |
| 📄 "未检索到"纪律 | 找不到时输出：覆盖范围 + 现有线索分级 + "这不等于不存在" |
| 💸 零强制付费 | Keyed 引擎(Tavily/Serper/博查/Exa/Firecrawl-Key)有免费额度，配置了才启用，缺失自动禁用并在 doctor 说明 |

@xiaowuwu/dsh-deep-search README · 架构：四模块，智能在模型、苦力在插件：```
你(规划器) ──生成 10-20 组查询──▶ deep_search(执行器：并行/去重/聚类/分级/预算)
     ▲                                          │
     └──解析+重写：读 extracted 实体 + hint◀────┘
               │ 找到 A 级公告 | 轮次尽 | 无新词
